banner: Not investment advice. This is one person's experiment: Mike's own capped money, traded by Mike's agents, broadcast as it happens. No one else's funds are involved, and nothing here is a signal to follow.

polymarket-us.label: Polymarket US
polymarket-us.note: Off until the VENUES.md confirm items clear (trade-only keys, API terms, public market-data paths).

excluded.note: Markets whose title, ticker or category contains any of these are refused by the gate. Mike adds to this list.

agents.name: Fade
agents.thesis: Longshots are overpriced. Buy NO on near-dated markets where YES trades at 8 cents or less.

agents.name: Closer
agents.thesis: Heavy favorites in their last 12 hours are slightly underpriced. Buy YES at 92 cents or more.

agents.name: Drift
agents.thesis: Hold broad ETFs while they close above their 20-day average; sell when they close below it.

agents.name: Guest
agents.thesis: A slot for one of Mike's AI agents (Claude, Codex) to propose orders through POST /propose. Same gate, same limits.
